prompt: A teammate pushed this Jest e2e spec (`users.e2e-spec.ts`) with a "review this before I merge" note, saying they made the suite "a bit faster" by trimming some setup. It boots the real Nest app against a live Postgres database and passes locally when run top-to-bottom — but you have to Ctrl+C the process afterward to get your prompt back. Review the file: name the real defects precisely (not "looks good"), trace each one's consequences, propose a fix that keeps the speed intent, and say exactly how you'd prove the fix works.
